pose_families.value: leaning back into a table, counter, or dresser edge with the hips pushed subtly back, one hand resting on the upper thigh, and the head turned toward camera
pose_families.safety_note: Keep the hand on thigh or hip only and avoid hem-lift or explicit partner pinning language.

pose_families.value: sitting sideways on a cube, ottoman, or low bench with the torso twisted toward camera and one hand settled on the front knee
pose_families.safety_note: Works best as a studio-fashion or hotel-editorial seat, not as a low-spicy lifestyle pose.

pose_families.value: leaning one hip into a kitchen island or counter while the fingers rise lightly to the collar or neckline
pose_families.safety_note: Keep the gesture collar-led and controlled; do not turn it into shirt-opening or undressing action.

pose_families.value: sitting on the bed with both knees angled to one side, one shoulder eased open, and one hand lightly controlling the sweater or hem at the hip
pose_families.safety_note: Keep the shoulder reveal soft and avoid underwear-first framing.

pose_families.value: kneeling on the bed with one hand anchored into the sheet or mattress and the torso pitched forward in a taut diagonal toward camera
pose_families.notes: Normalized from Romantic_00011_.png metadata and the safer body line from 1_1,5+2_4+1,5_dpmpp_2m+sgm__005_00001_.png.
pose_families.safety_note: Keep it clothed, face-led, and mattress-anchored; avoid all-fours or explicit rear-emphasis wording.

pose_families.value: sitting in a passenger seat with both legs angled sideways, one hand on the seatback, and the upper body twisted back toward camera
pose_families.safety_note: Use as a car-interior editorial shape, not a simulated makeout or explicit backseat lane.

pose_families.value: standing close to a wall or doorframe with one arm lifted above the head, the other hand dropped to the hip, and the ribcage stretched into a long S-curve
pose_families.notes: Pose shape normalized from Pinterest 2fd653dce43018f18adee38497f1442c.jpg; outfit itself was not imported literally.
pose_families.safety_note: Pair with clothed editorial styling and keep the hand placement away from explicit body-grab cues.
